messages:
sam_sales: Heads-up — POC customer acct=acct_QW12ER says free credits dropped from 20k -> 0 overnight and they saw many 429s. can we triage? :grimacing:
tara_support: on it. ask for their SDK version and a short log window.
sam_sales: they sent this log snippet and say they're on python sdk v1.3.9:
```
2026-03-22T04:05:12Z WARN timeout, retrying
2026-03-22T04:05:15Z INFO request sent tokens=1800 route=/v1/chat/completions
2026-03-22T04:05:18Z ERROR http 429
2026-03-22T04:05:22Z INFO request sent tokens=1800 route=/v1/chat/completions
2026-03-22T04:05:24Z INFO success req_id=req_b33 tokens=1800
```
dan_engineering: that pattern screams retry-after-timeout where both attempts end up consuming. if sdk v1.3.9 doesn't set idempotency, duplicates likely. pulling server logs for acct_QW12ER.
liam_billing: metering shows 19,800 units consumed between 2026-03-22T03:50Z and 2026-03-22T04:10Z; free_credit was 20,000 at 03:50. metering_bot, flagged anomaly?
metering_bot: anomaly: spike in repeated token counts (1800) for acct_QW12ER in 04:05 window. possible duplicate consumption pattern detected.
dan_engineering: confirmed duplicated reqs: approx 11 pairs of requests where first returned 408/timeout and later succeeded — both consumed tokens. rough duplicate volume ~9,900 units. recommend crediting ~9,900 and advise idempotency usage.
tara_support: can we temporarily lift soft rate limits for this POC while they patch? ops_bot?
ops_bot: concurrency increased for acct_QW12ER from 4 -> 12 for 8h. ticket infra_change_20260322_02.
liam_billing: I'll queue a goodwill credit of 9,900 units pending finance approval and note cause as client retries without idempotency.
sam_sales: i'll relay fix steps: upgrade SDK to v1.4.x (idempotency by default) and add X-Idempotency-Key on retries. customer replies: "Thanks — we'll pause replays and upgrade now." :thumbsup: closing thread unless approval stalls.
